input.plan:
# Light gray default text

The page background is already dark (`#141414` in [app/static/style.css](app/static/style.css) and `--nf-bg` in [app/static/nf.css](app/static/nf.css)). Bootstrap’s light theme still sets `--bs-body-color: #212529` and `--bs-emphasis-color: #000` on `:root`. Components that use those variables (cards, list items, emphasis text) render near-black on that background. `.nf-body` only sets an inherited `color`, so it does not fix those components. `--nf-text` stays white because play buttons and active chips use it as a fill, not only as text.

## Change

In the `body` rule in [app/static/style.css](app/static/style.css), set the default text color and the Bootstrap tokens that components actually read:

- `color: #d3d3d3` (CSS `lightgray`)
- `--bs-body-color` and `--bs-body-color-rgb` to match
- `--bs-emphasis-color` to a slightly lighter gray (`#e8e8e8`) so bold/heading emphasis is still light
- `--bs-secondary-color` to a translucent light gray so muted body text is not the dark `rgba(33, 37, 41, 0.75)` default

In [app/static/nf.css](app/static/nf.css), point `.nf-body`’s `color` at `#d3d3d3` instead of `var(--nf-text)`, so the theme default matches. Leave `--nf-text: #ffffff` unchanged.

In the same `style.css` file, change `.media-control-btn i` from `color: black` to `#d3d3d3`. That rule is the only explicit black text color; the control bar background is black.

## Check

Reload the library page and confirm shelf labels, cards, the bottom transport labels/icons, and the title overlay read as light gray on the dark background. Play buttons and active chips should stay white fills with dark labels.

todos.content: Set body text and Bootstrap color tokens to light gray in style.css
Point .nf-body color at the same light gray without changing --nf-text
Change media-control icon color from black to light gray

content.text:
Default UI text is now light gray (`#d3d3d3`) on the dark background.

- In `app/static/style.css`, `body` sets that color and the Bootstrap tokens components actually use (`--bs-body-color`, `--bs-emphasis-color`, `--bs-secondary-color`). Transport icons use the same gray.
- In `app/static/nf.css`, `.nf-body` uses `#d3d3d3`. `--nf-text` stays white, so play buttons and active chips stay white fills with dark labels.

Bootstrap tables and cards were still white, which would have made the new gray text unreadable. Those surfaces now use the same `#141414` background. Linen editor cards keep dark text.

Checked on the home library, the table page, and the editor: shelf and tile titles, the transport bar, and the table read as light text on the dark background, and the editor card stays dark text on linen.
